description: Tika's PListParserTest.testWebArchive on testWEBARCHIVE.webarchive: reported as application/x-bplist-webarchive and parsed by PListParser. Tika also reads the HTML inside the NSData as embedded documents (12 in all) and asserts on 'December 2008: Apache Tika Release' there; this port writes NSData as base64 and extracts no embedded documents, so that assertion is not made (tikajs-68os.21). The limit is raised because the base64 of the data is just over the default 100000 characters
